sections.title: Sound of C
paragraphs: The letter name is (C) /s/. Its main sound is heard in (cat) /kæt/, a small furry pet. This letter makes two sounds in English.

sections.title: How to say C
paragraphs: To make the first sound, lift the back of your tongue. Touch the soft roof of your mouth and stop the air. Release the air suddenly with no voice. For the second sound, put your tongue tip near the tooth ridge. Push air through the small gap to make a hiss. Keep your throat quiet. Feel no shaking in your throat.

sections.title: Spelling of C
paragraphs: The letter sounds like (cup) /kʌp/ before the letters a, o, u or a consonant. It sounds like (city) /sɪ.ti/ before the letters e, i or y. Listen to (cent) /sɛnt/ for this soft sound.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add voice to the sounds. When you say the first sound, your vocal cords must not shake. Keep the sound dry and light. When you say the second sound, blow clean air without your voice.
